subject: general
question:
Select the option that will replace the question mark (?) in the following figure series.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/19d67b9f955e79ce9960adf65f422f479d49f6509e51dbae76ac95a1d9caef74.png]
solution:
The logic followed here is :-

 
• Six sided polygon decreases on side from figure to figure by moving one step in clockwise.
 
• Line is moving one step clockwise from figure to figure.
 
• The darken part of rhombus moves +1 from 1st figure to 2ⁿd figure with in rhombus.
 
• The darken part of rhombus moves +2 from 2ⁿd figure to 3rd figure with in rhombus.
 
• The darken part of rhombus moves +3 from 4th figure to 3rd figure with in rhombus.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/533edceb6dba812e901b129fcdde116addb6b5849d646084487b14de94f3866c.png] 

Hence, the correct answer is **"option 4".**
